evidence.quote: Harbor Point Construction, Inc.
evidence.rationale: Preamble identifies Harbor Point Construction, Inc. as "Contractor".

evidence.quote: Delta Mechanical Systems, LLC
evidence.rationale: Preamble identifies Delta Mechanical Systems, LLC as "Subcontractor".

evidence.quote: Sacramento Unified School District
evidence.rationale: Recital identifies the Owner under the Prime Contract.

evidence.quote: Rosemont Elementary Modernization
evidence.rationale: Recital names the Project.

evidence.quote: This Subcontract is governed by the laws of the State of California.
evidence.rationale: Section 17.1 governing-law clause names California.

evidence.quote: This paragraph governs the time of payment and is not a condition that Owner pay before Subcontractor is entitled to be paid.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.3 ties payment timing to Owner payment but expressly states it is not a condition precedent.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor each progress payment within seven (7) days after Contractor receives payment from Owner for the Subcontract Work covered by that application.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.3 states seven days after Contractor receives Owner payment.

evidence.quote: The parties expressly agree in writing to this payment timing.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.3 expressly records written agreement to the payment period.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall withhold Retainage of five percent (5%) from each progress payment to Subcontractor.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.1 sets retainage at 5%, i.e. 500 basis points.

release_condition.value: upon Final Completion of the Subcontract Work and Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner

evidence.quote: Retainage shall be released to Subcontractor upon Final Completion of the Subcontract Work and Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.2 states both release conditions. Section 7.3 adds closeout document and waiver deliverables before release.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall pay Subcontractor the Retainage within ten (10) days after both of these conditions are satisfied.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.2 sets ten days after both conditions are satisfied.

evidence.quote: As a condition of each progress payment, Subcontractor shall deliver with its payment application a conditional waiver and release on progress payment covering the amount requested.
evidence.rationale: Section 8.1 requires a conditional progress waiver with each application.

evidence.quote: Within five (5) days after receiving each payment, Subcontractor shall deliver to Contractor an unconditional waiver and release covering the amount received.
evidence.rationale: Section 8.2 requires an unconditional waiver within five days after each payment.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor shall obtain and deliver to Contractor, with each payment application, matching conditional and unconditional waivers and releases from each of its lower-tier subcontractors and material suppliers
evidence.rationale: Section 8.3 requires lower-tier waivers with each application.

evidence.quote: All waivers and releases delivered under this Article shall be in the statutory forms prescribed by California Civil Code sections 8132, 8134, 8136, and 8138, as applicable.
evidence.rationale: Section 8.4 requires the California statutory forms.

evidence.quote: Contractor may set off against any amount due to Subcontractor under this Subcontract the amount of any backcharge for costs Contractor has incurred because of Subcontractor's acts or omissions,
evidence.rationale: Section 9.2 grants a backcharge setoff right. Section 9.3 adds notice requirements.

evidence.quote: Contractor may withhold from any payment due to Subcontractor an amount sufficient to cover the cost of correcting defective or nonconforming Subcontract Work, until the work has been corrected and accepted.
evidence.rationale: Section 9.1 permits withholding for defective work.

evidence.quote: Contractor will not pay for materials or equipment stored on the site or off the site.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.5 expressly excludes payment for stored materials, on or off site.

anomalies.description: Release of retainage is conditioned on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner. Owner non-payment of retention would delay release indefinitely.

evidence.quote: Retainage shall be released to Subcontractor upon Final Completion of the Subcontract Work and Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Release of retainage is conditioned on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner. Owner non-payment of retention would delay release indefinitely.

anomalies.description: Final Completion, a retainage release trigger, requires closeout documents to be accepted by Contractor. This adds a Contractor-discretion element.

evidence.quote: all closeout documents required by Article 13 and Article 2 have been delivered to and accepted by Contractor.
evidence.rationale: Final Completion, a retainage release trigger, requires closeout documents to be accepted by Contractor. This adds a Contractor-discretion element.

anomalies.description: Additional deliverables are required before retainage release: closeout documents, a statutory conditional final waiver, and final lower-tier lien releases.

evidence.quote: Before release of Retainage, Subcontractor shall deliver to Contractor the closeout documents required by Article 13, a conditional waiver and release on final payment in the statutory form, and final lien releases from all lower-tier suppliers and subcontractors as required by Article 8.
evidence.rationale: Additional deliverables are required before retainage release: closeout documents, a statutory conditional final waiver, and final lower-tier lien releases.

anomalies.description: Lower-tier unconditional waivers are required with each payment application, which may be before Subcontractor has been paid for that period. Check this timing against the conditional/unconditional sequence.

evidence.quote: matching conditional and unconditional waivers and releases from each of its lower-tier subcontractors and material suppliers who have furnished labor or materials for the period covered.
evidence.rationale: Lower-tier unconditional waivers are required with each payment application, which may be before Subcontractor has been paid for that period. Check this timing against the conditional/unconditional sequence.

anomalies.description: Broad additional withholding rights, including withholding tied to Owner withholding and to Contractor's evaluation that the balance is insufficient.

evidence.quote: Owner withholding attributable to the Subcontract Work; and reasonable evidence that the Subcontract Work cannot be completed for the unpaid balance of the Subcontract Sum.
evidence.rationale: Broad additional withholding rights, including withholding tied to Owner withholding and to Contractor's evaluation that the balance is insufficient.

anomalies.description: Stored materials are not payable until incorporated into the work, and Subcontractor bears risk of loss until installation.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor bears the risk of loss for all stored materials and equipment until they are installed.
evidence.rationale: Stored materials are not payable until incorporated into the work, and Subcontractor bears risk of loss until installation.

anomalies.description: Payment applications must include other documentation reasonably required by Contractor or Owner. This is an open-ended submission requirement.

evidence.quote: and any other documentation reasonably required by Contractor or Owner.
evidence.rationale: Payment applications must include other documentation reasonably required by Contractor or Owner. This is an open-ended submission requirement.
